Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: High - supply chain dependent on energy availability
Time_Horizon_Impact: Transition risk peaks 2030-2040 as coal demand falls. NPV severely negative in <2C scenario
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Coal assets face existential risk in 1.5C/2C scenarios. Stranded asset risk 60-80% of exposure.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - supply chain vulnerable to policy shocks
Time_Horizon_Impact: Regulatory risk materializes 2025-2035 with carbon pricing. Revenue impact -35% by 2040 in 1.5C
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Oil & Gas faces policy-driven transition risk. Upstream operations face commodity price collapse risk in low-carbon scenarios.

Time_Horizon_Impact: Solar assets benefit from transition. Physical risk minimal. Long-term revenue protected under all scenarios.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Renewable energy benefits from transition to low-carbon. Minimal climate exposure. Strategic value increases post-2030.

Time_Horizon_Impact: Wind farms resilient to climate change. Physical risks manageable with maintenance investment.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Renewable assets de-risk portfolio. Physical risks offset by operational resilience investments.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - tenants may relocate if climate worsens
Time_Horizon_Impact: Urban flood risk in Munich increases post-2035. Heat stress reduces rental income. Adaptation capex required 200-300M EUR by 2050.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Munich real estate faces increasing physical risk. Flood mitigation capex essential by 2040. Rental demand at risk from climate migration.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - residential demand stable but location-sensitive
Time_Horizon_Impact: Berlin faces urban heat island + occasional flooding. Migration risk if adaptation not implemented. Long-term demand uncertain.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Largest asset class. Physical risks moderate but consistent. Adaptation costs 250-400M EUR by 2050. Demand resilience depends on climate adaptation policy.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: High - highly dependent on water availability and growing seasons
Time_Horizon_Impact: Agricultural assets face severe drought risk in 1.5C/2C scenarios. Crop viability at risk. Supply chain disruption likely.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Agricultural sector most vulnerable to physical climate risks. Drought impact: -40-60% revenue in adverse scenarios. Adaptation through irrigation requires massive capex (100M+ EUR).

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Transition risk extreme - coal phase-out mandatory by 2030. Physical water stress risk high.
Time_Horizon_Impact: Coal power facing regulatory phase-out by 2030-2035 across EU. Physical risks (water stress) secondary to policy risk. Asset write-down likely by 2035.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Coal power plant faces existential risk. TCFD scenario analysis shows NPV = 0 or negative under 1.5C/2C. Immediate stranded asset risk.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - transition risk from carbon pricing. Physical risk from water stress.
Time_Horizon_Impact: Steel production faces EU carbon pricing (from 2025). Water stress risk in Ruhr region increasing. Capex for green steel transition 200-300M EUR by 2035.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Steel sector faces dual transition (technology + carbon pricing). Physical water risks moderate. Capex required for green steel conversion 200-300M EUR.

Time_Horizon_Impact: Transportation infrastructure faces increasing flooding/heat damage. Maintenance capex rising. Long-term viability depends on climate adaptation investment.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Infrastructure assets essential but climate-exposed. Flood/heat risk increasing across EU regions. Adaptation capex 300-500M EUR by 2050.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: High - water-dependent production, hazmat spillage risk under extreme events
Time_Horizon_Impact: Chemical production highly sensitive to water availability and extreme flood events. Capex for resilience 100-150M EUR by 2035.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Chemical manufacturing faces water stress + flood risks. Extreme event damage potential high. Capex for disaster-proofing essential.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: High - supply chain dependent on agricultural inputs vulnerable to climate shocks
Time_Horizon_Impact: Food processing vulnerable to agricultural supply shocks from drought. Flood risk in Netherlands. Supply chain adaptation capex 80-120M EUR.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Food processing faces severe supply chain risk from agricultural climate impacts. Flood/drought dual exposure. Capex for supply chain resilience essential.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: High - ocean ecosystem collapse risk, regulatory quotas shrinking
Time_Horizon_Impact: Fishing industry faces existential risk from ocean acidification + regulatory response. Revenue decline -30-50% by 2040 likely. Limited capex = divestment scenario.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Fishing assets face highest physical risk (ocean chemistry change). Regulatory quotas declining. NPV strongly negative by 2035 in all scenarios.

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - water scarcity increasing, but essential service status protects revenues
Time_Horizon_Impact: Water utilities face severe drought risk in Spain/S. Europe. Regulation ensures revenue protection, but capex for desalination/adaptation 250-400M EUR by 2040.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Water utilities face extreme physical risk (drought) but regulatory protection maintains revenues. Massive capex required for drought adaptation (desalination, storage).

Supply_Chain_Risk_Level: Medium - dependent on snow cover; climate change threatens business model
Time_Horizon_Impact: Alpine ski infrastructure faces severe physical risk (snow loss). Revenue decline -40-70% by 2050 likely. Transition to year-round tourism requires capex 100-150M EUR but demand uncertain.
Materiality_Assessment_Notes: Ski resort assets face existential risk from snow loss. Transition to summer tourism uncertain. High stranded asset risk by 2040-2050.
